title: fix(plugins): make SQLite SDK deprecations actionable
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Deprecated synchronous SQLite SDK calls share warning budgets across whole capability families, so one call can hide another method's migration warning. Several entrypoints omit warnings, and some migration advice names methods that do not exist.

## User Impact

Each deprecated SQLite method now warns once per plugin per process, including across plugin reloads. Missing diagnostics cover the runtime session getter, extension binding, model-provider unregister, ACP resolution, native binding preparation, transcript compatibility callbacks, and legacy state/conversation-binding factories. Prepared-query helpers warn at preparation without wrapping later executions. Awaited/prepared paths stay quiet.

JSDoc and the plugin migration guide use the existing policy: final compatibility day **2026-12-31**, with removal in the **first January 2027 stable release**, only after the deprecation and working replacement ship together in an earlier stable. The guide maps methods to replacements and includes migration examples. No shipped method is removed and no SDK major is introduced.

## Design and Scope

Synchronous completion and authority semantics remain unchanged. Shared private implementations avoid misleading nested warnings for native authority and model-registry adapters. This changes warnings and documentation, with no SQL, schema, credential, approval, or lifecycle policy change. No defensive authority checks are removed and no new race window is accepted.

Reserved memory diagnostics and effect-boundary callers remain explicit follow-ups. The separate Discord change migrates a bundled caller; Telegram and prepared-authority owner work remain outside this PR. A lower-bound ClawHub scan found 15 plugins referencing the runtime session getter (14 runtime, one type reference; 2,027 complete, 380 partial, one failed scan among 2,408 eligible releases). This is not evidence that the API can be removed now.

## Evidence

- Both isolated Codex review rounds, changed-file formatting and type-aware lint passed.
- Final-head CI [38997189919](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38997189919) completed with 107 successful jobs and 24 skipped jobs; it passed types, lint, source contracts, architecture/Madge, SDK surface and database ratchets, including the corrected warning-budget fixtures. Remaining CI status is recorded below.
- The runtime API guardrail passed. Canonical SDK declaration comparison (`7034ca42b491` → `5c86f9a5f067`, followed only by two own test fixes and main integration) found no entrypoint or public signature changes. Its 157 affected-export closure records come solely from private `ExtensionRunner.bindCoreActions` and `ModelRegistry.refreshFromStorage` declarations.
- Canonical final-head Knip reports two unused exports in both production/full-tree modes, scripts zero: `combined-store-paths.ts:discoveryReadOptions` and `node-list-types.ts:NODE_APPROVAL_STATE_VALUES`. The exact same rules/files were reproduced on main `3415f6a4ee43`; source and checker blobs match this head. Earlier unrelated export failures were resolved by integrating main's fixes.

| Metric | Base | Candidate |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Static T1 call sites | 186 | 186 |
| T1 compatibility sites | 10 | 10 |
| Warmed statements/requests/MAIN | Not measured | No SQL change or savings claim |

The LRU fork-count test in `runtime-llm.prepared-owner.test.ts` is independently reproduced on main ancestor `5e5ad805485b` (expected 2, received 3); its relevant source is unchanged. All six `settled-turn-finalizer.native.test.ts` failures were reproduced on exact main parent `022e167dbd2936586439c72c0a3302dc88f7a67f`: missing warning at line 618 and missing settled-tool context at line 805. Main commit `acd27635` moved capture into `onSettledTurn`, which this unchanged fixture omits. The targeted synthetic run reported 6 failed / 3 skipped, matching CI. PostgreSQL conformance passed. The two inherited test jobs and their aggregate CI gate are the only failed jobs; these and the two inherited Knip findings are recorded for the main-fix owner. Landing uses the authorized inherited-failure exception.

No update cell is required: no update, Doctor, migration, plugin-loading or service-lifecycle behavior changes. LOC: **110 files, +814 / -308**, predominantly existing JSDoc. Stable publication remains a prerequisite for future removal.
